input.quote: 2.1 Hosting Software License. Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, Commerce One hereby grants to Corio a fee-bearing, perpetual and irrevocable, nonexclusive, nontransferable (except in accordance with Section 14.1 of this Agreement), right and license in the Territory to (i) reproduce the Software in machine executable object code format only for installation on the Corio Servers;
input.rationale: The grants run to Corio alone. The revocability and transfer prongs are satisfied: the hosting licence is "perpetual and irrevocable", the internal-use and demonstration licences are royalty-free/fully paid (2.2 also perpetual), and Section 14.1 permits assignment to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets without consent, so the licences follow us in an M&A transaction. Contractors are largely accommodated indirectly (Corio Servers are those "owned or operated by or for Corio", and 2.1(iv) allows unlimited Customer sublicensing). However, our affiliates are nowhere covered and there is no notice or other mechanism to add them, so the clause fails even the fallback position on that material term. We propose a single new Section 2.11 extending the Section 2 licences to our affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, with Corio remaining responsible for their compliance; a written-notice affiliate mechanic is offered as fallback.

ops.text: 2.11 Affiliates and Contractors. All licenses granted to Corio under this Section 2 extend to Corio's affiliates (any entity controlling, controlled by or under common control with Corio) and to contractors acting on Corio's behalf, provided that Corio remains responsible for their compliance with the terms of this Agreement.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a short subsection extending the Section 2 licenses to our affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, with us remaining responsible for their compliance, since our playbook requires the grant to reach affiliates and contractors. If preferred, we can instead limit this to affiliates identified by written notice to Commerce One.
proposal.summary: Extend Section 2 licences to Corio's affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf.
